Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.04389

Status: **refuted** according to the source (as of October 2024). “Recall that girth conjecture has been refuted by Kochol in where he constructed snarks of arbitrary large girth.”
source_name: Vahan Mkrtchyan, “Non-conflicting no-where zero Z_2Z_2 flows in cubic graphs”, arXiv:2410.04389 (2024).
statement:
Let $G$ be a bridgeless cubic graph, and let $\chi'_{N}(G)$ be its normal chromatic index. **Šámal's conjecture.** Every bridgeless cubic graph $G$ satisfies

$$
\chi'_{N}(G)\leq 6.
$$

This is presented as an intermediate goal toward the stronger normal chromatic-index bound $\chi'_{N}(G)\leq 5$ and remains open.
title: Šámal's normal chromatic-index conjecture
